items.title: Is Kimi K3 Really Fable Class?
items.summary: The month of models rolls on, and Kimi K3 arrives with the boldest claim yet: a Fable-5-class open model on your desk. NLW unpacks the two-reaction cycle — the euphoric UI demos, then the sober debugging failures, brutal token costs, and near-total absence of guardrails — to figure out whether China really just closed the gap to under three months.
